deliverables: Open, standardized interface across Cardano's leading on-chain protocols
Documentation, auto-generated SDKs in multiple languages, and live JSON-RPC endpoints from verified interface definitions
Agent-first documentation, protocol skills packaging operations, and an MCP server for agents to discover and call published protocols
12 additional protocol onboardings over 12 months, stated as 3 per quarter
Use of Intersect treasury management smart contracts with milestone-based disbursement controls
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tx3 by TxPipe as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Tx3 is described as producing documentation, auto-generated multi-language SDKs, and live JSON-RPC endpoints from a verified interface definition for each protocol.
The proposal says Catalyst Fund 14 has already put the Tx3 developer layer into production with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.
The proposal commits to funding 12 additional protocol onboardings, at 3 per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage.
The proposal states that protocols including Strike Finance, Indigo Protocol, VyFinance, Bodega Market, and Fluid Tokens are already accessible through Tx3.
The proposal asserts that a shared interface layer will reduce integration costs, avoid repeated protocol-specific relearning, and improve cross-protocol composability.
The proposal asserts that AI agents need shared deterministic interface infrastructure because hallucinated on-chain transactions can move assets irreversibly.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

The proposal states that TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, and also received 2025 Intersect open-source maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for TxPipe's Tx3 project, primarily to expand protocol onboarding and add agent-facing infrastructure, with Intersect-managed smart contract custody and oversight; several governance and registry references are checkable, but many core benefit, feasibility, and delivery claims are asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
